attributes.title: VECCS Spring Symposium 2027, Napa Valley
attributes.organizer: Veterinary Emergency and Critical Care Society
attributes.summary:
The VECCS Spring Symposium in Napa Valley runs April 1 to 4, 2027, at the Napa Valley Marriott Hotel & Spa and offers 18 CE hours in veterinary emergency and critical care. The event is open to VECCS members only.

Veterinarians pay $700 through January 7, 2027, and $800 afterwards; technicians, interns, residents, practice managers and students pay $550, then $650. Rooms start at $299 per night; attendees who stay outside the room block may be charged an extra $500 if the block does not fill. A second 2027 Spring Symposium takes place in Costa Rica.
